不选择客户导出器时使用默认导出：CSV、DCL、CsvMes。选择客户导出器后，: Without a customer exporter, use the default CSV, DCL and CsvMes exports. When selected, run only that exporter after each test.
当前账号仅可修改保存路径。: This account can change save paths only.
发送 Itemnum 后未收到 Item1 首段时的再次请求等待时间: Delay before retrying when Item1 does not arrive after Itemnum
固定当前采集画面，单次识别；仅测试，不触发生产扫码: Freeze the current frame for one recognition test; does not trigger production scanning
关闭 Web API 后，MES 连接只检查数据库，跳过员工上机、过站和复判接口: With Web API off, MES connection checks only the database. Employee login, station pass and recheck APIs are skipped. Inspection data still writes to enabled tables; API states remain not passed / not rechecked.
关闭时，MES 连接跳过员工上机接口及员工上下机记录。启用时，上机许可通过后写入: When off, skip the employee login API and clock records. When on, record clock-in after authorization and clock-out when going offline or exiting.
记录二次良率：首次 FAIL 暂不上传 MES，以同一 SN 的第二次结果为准上: Track second-pass yield: delay MES upload after the first FAIL and use the second result for the same SN
嘉联益 CareerRule MES 会复用默认 MES 基础资料；其他客户 M: JiaLianYi CareerRule MES uses the default MES basics; other MES plugins keep only their own settings.
昆山嘉联益专用模式启动后会自动连接扫码枪和下位机；此处仅显示当前连接状态。: Kunshan JiaLianYi mode automatically connects the scanner and controller at startup; this page shows connection status only.
连接测试完成后会释放设备；正式扫码请保存并退出本页，然后在主界面连接扫码枪。: The device is released after a connection test. To scan in production, save and close this page, then connect the scanner on the main screen.
两项插件已由昆山嘉联益模式锁定，不能修改。相同资料只需填写一次，会同时用于 ME: Kunshan JiaLianYi mode locks both plugins. Enter shared settings once for MES and export.
留空则不校验条码位数: Leave blank to skip barcode length validation
每行一个请求头，格式：名称: 值。示例：Authorization: Beare: One request header per line, format: Name: Value. Example: Authorization: Bearer token
默认 10 秒；超时后向下位机发送 DMNG: Default: 10 seconds. Send DMNG to the controller on timeout.
默认发送 IsOpen，独立收到 1 才算成功；等待时长使用上方超时(ms)。仅: Send IsOpen by default; success requires a separate reply of 1. Uses the timeout above. Enable only when supported by the controller.
启用后，当天的 PASS、FAIL、总数和良率会在软件重启后保留；次日启动时自动: Preserve today's PASS, FAIL, total and yield across restarts; reset them on the next day.
启用后连接时发送上方的测试项请求命令，收到完整有效的 Item1...;end: On connection, send the test item request above; a complete valid Item1...;end reply confirms success. Select only one handshake method. With neither selected, an open serial port confirms connection.
生产模式和调试模式请在基础资料页面切换。生产模式按下列良率规则控制上传。: Switch between production and debug modes on the Basic Information page. Production uploads follow the yield rules below.
使用手动对焦。保存后在主界面连接扫码枪，生产触发时识别二维码 / Data Ma: Use manual focus. After saving, connect the scanner on the main screen to recognize QR / Data Matrix codes when production triggers. Choose a supported resolution; the driver may use another one if unsupported. Check the actual frame in camera preview.
未勾选时，与上一笔实际开始测试相同的条码将被阻止；先测试其他条码后可再次测试。: When off, a barcode matching the previous started test is blocked. Test another barcode before using it again.
未选择客户导出器时，以下即为原“基础配置”的 CSV、DCL 与保存规则。: Without a customer exporter, the following are the original basic CSV, DCL and save rules.
先核对原始结果与工单，再选择记录执行补写；补过站与复判只在 MES 在线时执行。: Check the original result and work order before selecting records to write. Station pass and recheck retries run only while MES is online.
由 Windows 自动识别并连接 POS HID 条形码扫描器。该模式无需串口: Windows detects and connects a POS HID barcode scanner automatically. No serial port, baud rate or trigger command is needed; scan using the scanner button.
在右侧画面拖动鼠标框选码区。保存后正式扫码先识别选区，失败再识别整幅画面。: Drag on the image to select the code area. After saving, production scanning checks that area first, then the full image if needed.
CSV 文件使用现有单片 CSV 导出；IMGCONTENT 保存本机路径。景旺: CSV uses the existing per-unit export; IMGCONTENT stores a local path. Confirm the shared path before JingWang reads it.
MES 基础设置和所选 MES 插件的专有参数统一在此维护。: Manage shared MES basics and the selected plugin's settings here.
MES 在线时可选择；每天 08:00 和 20:00 自动恢复为标准片模式。: Available while MES is online; automatically returns to reference unit mode at 08:00 and 20:00 daily.
Supereyes 请以 USB 摄像头接入。打开本页前请关闭原厂 Supere: Connect Supereyes as a USB camera. Close the original Supereyes software before opening this page so the device is available.
USB Video Device / UVC 摄像头扫码: USB Video Device / UVC Camera Scanning

对照通讯日志检查原始报文及当前协议配置，报文异常不等同于硬件损坏。: Compare the raw message and current protocol settings with the communication log. A malformed message does not by itself indicate hardware damage.
检查供电、连接线、端口、波特率或网络地址。: Check power, cable, port, baud rate or network address.

检查通讯连接；发送失败不代表下位机已经收到命令。: Check the connection; a failed send does not mean the controller received the command.
检查通讯连接及请求命令；请区分发送失败和下位机未回复。: Check the connection and request command; distinguish a send failure from no controller reply.
检查通讯状态及请求配置。: Check communication status and request settings.

检查下位机连接后重新启动流程。: Check the controller connection and restart the process.
检查相机连接及设备选择。: Check the camera connection and selected device.
检查字段数量、分隔符和连续编号；已保留原表头，等待有效新表头。: Check field count, delimiters and sequence numbers. The previous header remains active until a valid new one arrives.
确认下位机握手回复内容及通讯配置。: Check the controller handshake reply and communication settings.
确认下位机支持握手命令，检查通讯参数和接线。: Confirm controller support for the handshake command; check settings and wiring.
检查报文长度、分隔符和结束标记 end。: Check message length, delimiters and the end marker.
